$comment: Records WHICH publicly available document each rule was mapped from, and whether that document was actually checked. Source verification proves provenance only. It does NOT mean the publisher reviewed, endorsed or validated CareBridge, and it does NOT constitute clinical approval. Full article text is deliberately not copied — title, section, a short summary and a content hash are enough to detect drift.
endorsementDisclaimer: None of the publishers listed below has reviewed, approved or endorsed CareBridge. CareBridge maps publicly available guidance into its own rule set; any mapping error is CareBridge's, not the publisher's.

sources.title: Interagency Integrated Triage Tool (IITT) — triage and treatment in the emergency unit, >=12 years
sources.notes: Canonical URL identified via WHO site search. The PDF was NOT fetched and hashed in this session, so the status stays PENDING rather than SOURCE_VERIFIED.
sources.intendedAudience: Trained health workers in facility-based emergency units
limitations: IITT is a FACILITY-BASED triage tool intended for trained health workers in emergency care settings.
CareBridge is NOT an official WHO IITT implementation.
CareBridge RED/YELLOW/GREEN are its own risk-orientation categories, not IITT triage categories.
CareBridge maps only a small subset of publicly documented danger signs.

overallStatusNote: No source has been fetched and content-hashed in this session. WHO_IITT_ADULT has a resolved canonical URL; WHO_DANGER_SIGNS_2022, WHO_MATERNAL_2025 and WHO_PCPNC_2015 remain unresolved to an exact edition/section; BYT_1139_2026 could not be located at all (UNRESOLVED_SOURCE). derivationRule: Rule-level sourceVerificationStatus is DERIVED from this manifest by DevTools/sync_triage_rule_registry.py and must never be hand-edited in the registry. All required sources SOURCE_VERIFIED -> SOURCE_VERIFIED; any PENDING/UNRESOLVED_SOURCE -> PENDING; any BROKEN -> BROKEN; any SOURCE_CHANGED -> SOURCE_CHANGED.
